title: Your local vision lab
summary: Read a tensor, inspect a batch and set up a reproducible local Python environment.
checks: Environment check passes and versions are recorded
I can explain NCHW, RGB, float32 and the label dtype
I can run a module from the repository root

title: Count objects with OpenCV
summary: Turn a photograph into a binary mask and a measured object count.
checks: Saved the source photo, mask and annotated count
Compared two area/kernel settings against a manual count
Explained a merged-object or illumination failure

title: Build and audit your dataset
summary: Write label rules, inspect duplicates and split independent groups before training.
checks: Wrote label definitions and source/group metadata
Resolved corrupt images, duplicates and missing groups
Saved a fixed manifest and inspected class counts in every split

title: Train a real-image classifier
summary: Train a small CNN on CIFAR-10, compare a baseline and inspect confident errors.
checks: Saved a protocol, learning history and validation predictions
Compared accuracy and class recall with the majority baseline
Explained three failures and kept the test set untouched

title: Transfer learning and fine-tuning
summary: Train a pretrained ResNet head, then unfreeze it for a controlled fine-tuning experiment.
checks: Completed a frozen-head experiment on the fixed split
Completed fine-tuning initialized from the frozen model
Compared validation results and explained frozen BatchNorm

title: Debug and resume training
summary: Use learning curves, reproducible resume and one-change experiments to diagnose training.
checks: Rendered a learning-curve report and interpreted the gap
Resumed last.pt with matching settings
Ran one controlled comparison and recorded its limitation

title: Detect people in photographs
summary: Fine-tune a detector, inspect boxes and compute explicitly defined AP50.
checks: Verified boxes and masks before training
Saved trained weights, AP50 and prediction overlays
Explained duplicate detections, missing objects and the AP convention

title: Segment people pixel by pixel
summary: Train a small U-Net and compare foreground overlap against an all-background baseline.
checks: Verified categorical masks and joint spatial transforms
Compared foreground IoU/Dice with the background baseline
Inspected boundary errors and explained semantic versus instance masks

title: Align views and track motion
summary: Estimate a robust homography and track image features through a short video.
checks: Saved inlier matches, a warp and reprojection errors
Saved a tracked video and feature survival statistics
Explained parallax, occlusion and why feature tracks are not object IDs

title: Retrieve images and prompt masks
summary: Use CLIP and SAM, then measure how wording and point prompts affect their outputs.
checks: Saved CLIP rankings for two prompt wordings
Saved SAM masks for two points on the same image
Distinguished similarity/predicted quality from measured accuracy

title: Use your model on new photos
summary: Reload a saved classifier, preserve preprocessing and measure warm inference latency.
checks: Reloaded best.pt and predicted a new local photograph
Recorded latency scope, hardware and preprocessing
Documented an unknown-class or shifted-image failure

title: Build an independent CV project
summary: Choose your data and task, defend the evaluation, and hand over a reproducible result.
checks: Completed the project report with fixed data and comparison protocol
Evaluated the held-out test only after choosing the model
Reproduced inference from the saved artifact and documented three failures
